# BarFlow

> BarFlow makes two Windows programs for rebar detailers, structural engineers and contractors: BarFlow BBS (bar bending schedules in Excel) and BarFlow Cutting Plan (rebar cutting plans that minimise waste). Both have English and Arabic interfaces and work offline. Website: https://barflowapp.com — Support: support@barflowapp.com

## Products
- [BarFlow BBS](https://barflowapp.com/): an Excel workbook (Windows) with standard shape codes (BS 8666) drawn for every shape, automatic cutting length with bend deductions, weights, print-ready sheets and DXF export to AutoCAD. Free version available; paid licences on the pricing page.
- [BarFlow Cutting Plan](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9N9P9HSBWGD3): a Windows program (also on the Microsoft Store) that takes a bar list and plans which stock bars to buy and how to cut each one, with waste, weight, cost and a purchase order in Excel. The first 3 runs are free.
- [Pricing](https://barflowapp.com/#pricing-en)

## Guides
- [How to choose rebar bar bending schedule software, with a real slab example](https://barflowapp.com/guides/choosing-rebar-bbs-software.html): what to look for; a real slab of about 8.1 tonnes where stock lengths changed the steel bought by about 2.5 tonnes (12 m only: about 24% waste; 4-10 m: under 0.1%).
- [Bar bending schedule guide](https://barflowapp.com/guides/bar-bending-schedule-guide.html)
- [Rebar weight and cutting length](https://barflowapp.com/guides/rebar-weight-and-cutting-length.html)
- [How to cut rebar with less waste](https://barflowapp.com/guides/reduce-rebar-waste-cutting-plan.html)
- [Arabic version of the guide above](https://barflowapp.com/ar/guides/choosing-rebar-bbs-software.html)
- Arabic guides: https://barflowapp.com/ar/guides/

## Videos (real ground-floor slab, about 8,140 kg / 1,557 bars)
- [Part 1, bar bending schedule from drawing to weights (English)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JN59EYNJuJc): reading bar labels, entering bars in BarFlow BBS, checking weights by hand, bend deduction of a U-bar (2510 → 2460 mm), totals, printing and DXF export. 6:41.
- [Part 2, cutting plan and waste (English)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QTfI34C2VOI): 12 m bars only gave about 24% waste; lengths from 4 to 10 m gave under 0.1%, about 2,550 kg of steel less. 5:42.
- Arabic versions: [part 1](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hhkhok79NmQ) (7:09), [part 2](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vO9CeYX5_L8) (6:04).
- Results in the videos are for that project only; users must check their own results.

## Facts
- Platform: Windows only (BBS runs inside Microsoft Excel). Not a BIM tool: it does not read 3D models.
- Languages: English and Arabic.
- Results should always be checked by the user before ordering or cutting steel.
- Channels: YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@barflowapp , LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/barflowapp
